description: This Java class defines PresentationMessageMap, a custom implementation of the Map interface that manages PresentationMessage objects, all in the same locale, for use in the OpenMRS messaging system.

classes.name: PresentationMessageMap
classes.description: A Map implementation that stores PresentationMessage objects, ensuring they belong to a specific locale.

methods.name: PresentationMessageMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with a specific locale.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the map.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the map.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the map's entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the PresentationMessage associated with a key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the keys.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the map if the value's locale matches the map's locale.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from another map, filtering out messages with non-matching locales.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated message from the map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values in the map.
